question: From what source do the teachings shine forth and can there be any other cause?
premises: The teachings shine forth from the power of the Bhairava-sun alone.
No other source accounts for their manifestation.
Apart from the reflective awareness of consciousness there can be no other cause anywhere.
inference: The teachings manifest solely from the reflective awareness of consciousness, symbolized as the power of the Bhairava-sun.
plain_english: They shine forth from the power of the Bhairava-sun alone, not from elsewhere; for apart from the reflective awareness of consciousness there could be no other cause anywhere at all.
